why: Duplicate of "The Music Man" (4ba1df04-2b14-46d2-a7ac-74ceed86b943): the same production in the same building, kept as a separate row only because the venue is spelled "Ordway Center for the Performing Arts" here and "Ordway Music Theater" on the keeper, which is why neither event_key nor roomKey ever folded them. This row covers 26 Dec 14:00 to 27 Dec 22:00 - exactly the last weekend of the keeper's run, matching the Ordway's own Saturday 2:00 PM and Sunday 1:30/7:00 PM performances. It says so itself: its stored description reads "The Music Man plays at the Ordway Center for the Performing Arts December 8-27, 2026, with performances available through December 27. The final days of the run fall within the December 26-27 window." It is a fragment minted from msp.kidsoutandabout.com's "101 ideas for holiday family fun" roundup, whose December 26-27 window became the event's dates; its ticket link is only ordway.org's homepage, while the keeper cites the Ordway's own event page. Archived, not hidden: the performances are real and only this row's date range is wrong, so the lever is the duplicate one rather than the takedown for a fabrication. The keeper's span was corrected to 27 Dec on 10 Nov 2026, which is what put the two rows side by side on /day/2026-12-26 and /day/2026-12-27.
